findings.current: A car sped through a red light and struck a pedestrian in the crosswalk.
findings.defect: The Korean says the car ignored the signal, but does not specify that it was red. The translation adds that detail.
findings.rationale: 신호를 무시하고 means the driver ignored the signal; it does not establish the signal’s color.
findings.replacement: A car sped through without regard for the signal and struck a pedestrian in the crosswalk.

findings.current: Sharper than spearheads and as fast as arrows, bone fragments rained down on the intersection.
findings.defect: The translation omits that thousands of bone fragments were fired simultaneously and that they broke scales and tore fins.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes 수천 개 (thousands) being fired at once, breaking scales, and tearing fins. The accepted baseline also preserved these details.
findings.replacement: Thousands of bone fragments shot down at once, sharper than spearheads and as fast as arrows, crushing scales and tearing through fins.

findings.current: Nearly half of the two hundred Mermen collapsed in an instant.
findings.defect: The assembled version drops the source’s time marker: this happened in only a dozen or so seconds.
findings.rationale: 불과 십여 초 specifies that only around a dozen seconds had passed. The accepted baseline retained this duration.
findings.replacement: In barely a dozen seconds, nearly half of the two hundred Mermen collapsed.

findings.current: I poured all my internal energy into it and drove the spear down toward the creature’s eye.
findings.defect: The translation omits the flames wrapped around the spearhead and their sharp rotation.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes the flames around the spearhead rotating sharply before the strike; the accepted baseline preserved that physical detail.
findings.replacement: The flames wrapped around the spearhead spun sharply. I poured all my internal energy into the strike and drove the spear down toward the creature’s eye.

summary: The scene is mostly faithful, but the assembled version drops a time marker and attack details, and adds an unsupported traffic-light color.
